articles.title: Berkeley Group Holdings (LSE:BKG) Stock May Be 37% Undervalued On Cash Flow
articles.summary: Berkeley Group Holdings has seen its share price climb sharply in recent weeks, which puts fresh focus on a simple question: Is the current £37.70 price tag supported by the cash the business is expected to generate over time? The stock has risen 18.5% over the past month, which raises the stakes on whether that quick rebound is backed up by its underlying cash flows.
